Rosenbauer America is hiring an Embedded Software Engineer to develop software for fire truck electrical systems. The role supports product development, production, and issue resolution through collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Automotive
Logistics
Manufacturing
Responsibilities
Develop and support embedded software for vehicle control systems
Collaborate with global and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products
Design, test, and validate software and system improvements
Troubleshoot and resolve product issues through corrective actions and continuous improvement
Provide technical support to internal teams and suppliers

Required
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or computer science
1 - 3 years of experience with embedded systems
Experience with low voltage electrical systems
Experience with signal processing
Read and interpret common scientific and technical journals and documents
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference
Interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables
Able to apply mathematical concepts to software solutions
Emphasis will be placed on analytical and problem-solving skills
Define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
Prioritizes and manages multiple projects and objectives as well as handling unscheduled tasks
Prepares and presents project status reports

Microsoft Office Products

Able to work in Agile SDLC
Test software using various processes such as Unit and Regression testing
Microsoft Visio experience
Knowledgeable in SAE J1939 and CANopen protocol
Familiar with Peak tools such as PCAN Explorer
Knowledgeable in QML and QtCreator
